scope: Supplement to analysis_153036/stop_recovery_review.json, using the completed 240.116 s capture; first stop audit is not repeated. No runtime changes or new acquisition.
time_basis: Logs are ordered by source timestamp relative to goal receive time. Topic events use bag receipt times; receipt order across different topics is not publication order.

second_stop.cause: Live LiDAR input timeout: source +177.7396 s says age 0.752 s exceeds 0.750 s; Depth Lost emergency stop follows at source +177.7403 s.
second_stop.branch: Same perception-timeout / PERCEPTION_RECOVERY branch as the first stop. Not evidence of a collision-triggered transient-obstacle recovery branch.
second_stop.goal_retention: One goal message across the complete capture. Source +179.6753 s recovery log explicitly validates the accepted goal before releasing the transient stop.
second_stop.esdf_gate: Source +179.6025/+179.6026 s freezes and waits for required ESDF seq 1402 while current ESDF is 1401, in PERCEPTION_RECOVERY.
second_stop.publication_order_caveat: ADD segment 1 arrives +179.6777 s, safety=-1 arrives +179.6778 s, ADD segment 2 arrives +179.6930 s. Cross-topic receipt order cannot establish that segment 2 was published after safety release. Source recovery path calls sendPolyTrajROSMsg before finishNewTrajectory/safety release.

finish_acceptance.confirmed: Planner published /planning/finish=true at +237.6809 s after the two recorded perception-stop recoveries.
finish_acceptance.confirmed_limit: The robot was not stationary at the finish event: adjacent odom longitudinal speeds are -0.06926 and -0.07744 m/s; angular speeds are -0.08981 and -0.10486 rad/s. Eight nonzero commands are recorded after finish, last at +239.6200 s.
finish_acceptance.pose_acceptance_status: Not independently certified in this audit. navigation_evidence.jsonl has odom x/y but no quaternion/frame or joint values. Supplementary yaw_review.json identifies goal frame world and odom frame odom, so direct subtraction is not a verified world-frame goal residual. Independent goal-frame pose, yaw, arm and settling checks remain necessary.
finish_acceptance.source_gate_context: Current FSM source checks measured position/yaw/arm against tolerances before normal manual finish, but that source-level check and a Bool success message do not substitute for independent recorded pose verification.

refresh_acceptance.conclusion: No actual MPPIRefresh event is recorded in the complete capture. Neither recovery ADD sequence is evidence of MPPIRefresh; this feature remains unvalidated by this run.

run_wide_fault_evidence.runtime_state_caveat: MPPI freshness/deadline rejections persist; nine waiting_explicit_arm_enable_or_normal_status and three state_feedback_stale states are recorded despite the extracted Piper execution states remaining normal. This audit does not assign the underlying cause.
